# Advance Auto Parts

> Advance Auto Parts is a comprehensive online automotive retail platform offering replacement parts, batteries, accessories, and in-store services for DIY and professional mechanics.

The site serves as a full-service auto parts retailer with an extensive catalog of engine, braking, and maintenance components, complemented by free loaner tools, in-store testing services, and a rewards program for customer loyalty.

## Key Topics

- Auto Parts Retail
- Replacement Parts
- Batteries & Accessories
- In-Store Pickup
- Loaner Tools
- Car Maintenance
- Engine Parts
- Braking Systems
- Advance Rewards Program
- In-Store Services
- Free Rental
- Vehicle Parts Finder
- Automotive Service
- Oil Change Supplies
- Same Day Service

## Shop by Category

- [Engine - Advance Auto Parts](https://shop.advanceautoparts.com/c1/engine/81542): Engine parts catalog including gaskets, seals, cylinders, and timing components.
- [Braking - Advance Auto Parts](https://shop.advanceautoparts.com/c1/braking/81536): Braking system parts catalog with pads, rotors, calipers, and hardware.
- [Certified A/C Pro Super Seal A/C Stop Leak Treatment ACPMRL3-6 - Advance Auto Parts](https://shop.advanceautoparts.com/p/certified-a-c-pro-a-c-pro-super-seal-a-c-stop-leak-kit-3-ounces-acpmrl3-6/12021717-P): Product listing for A/C stop leak treatment with R-134a compatibility.

## Store Services & Tools

- [Loaner Tools - Free Rental at Advance Auto Parts](https://shop.advanceautoparts.com/o/loaner-tools?gclsrc=aw.ds): Free loaner tool rental service for DIY automotive repairs with expert advice.
- [Shop Car Parts, Batteries & Accessories | Advance Auto Parts](https://shop.advanceautoparts.com/o/storeservices): In-store services including battery, starter, alternator testing and installation.
